plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Production-readiness audit for AI agent harnesses. Runs against your agent's real repo and traces, scores 44 runtime controls with file:line evidence, assigns a maturity band, and emits a prioritized fix queue. No artifact, no pass.
